servers.name: GitHub
servers.description: Issues, pull requests, code search and Actions in your repositories.

token.label: Personal access token
token.help: Make one at github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens. GitHub signs in other apps with OAuth only for apps it has registered.

servers.name: Linear
servers.description: Find, create and update Linear issues, projects and comments.

token.label: API key
token.help: Linear → Settings → Account → Security & access → API keys.

servers.name: Notion
servers.description: Search, read and edit pages and databases in your Notion workspace.

servers.name: Sentry
servers.description: Look up errors, issues and releases in Sentry.

servers.name: Atlassian
servers.description: Jira issues and Confluence pages, through Atlassian's Rovo MCP server.

token.label: Service account API key
token.help: A service account's API key. A personal API token needs Basic auth instead: add it as a custom server.

servers.name: Figma
servers.description: Read designs, frames and variables from Figma files.

servers.name: Figma (desktop app)
servers.description: The MCP server inside the Figma desktop app, while it's open. Needs a Dev or Full seat.

servers.name: Stripe
servers.description: Customers, payments, invoices and Stripe's docs.

token.label: Restricted API key (agent)
token.help: A restricted key made for agent access, with only the access you want to give.

servers.name: Supabase
servers.description: Manage Supabase projects: tables, SQL, migrations, logs. For development projects, not production data.

token.label: Personal access token
token.help: Supabase → Account → Access tokens. Add ?project_ref=…&read_only=true to the address to narrow it.

servers.name: Vercel
servers.description: Projects, deployments and logs on Vercel.

servers.name: Context7
servers.description: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks.

servers.name: Exa
servers.description: Web search and code context from Exa.

servers.name: Playwright
servers.description: Drive a browser from accessibility snapshots. Kothar's own Browser extension does this too.

servers.name: Filesystem
servers.description: Read and write files in the folders you pick, and nowhere else.

servers.name: Fetch
servers.description: Fetch web pages and turn them into Markdown. Needs uv (uvx).

servers.name: Memory
servers.description: A knowledge graph agents keep across chats, in a local file.

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.description: Web, news, image and local search from Brave's API.

token.label: Brave Search API key
token.help: From your Brave Search API dashboard.
